integrity: The result rests on a fully stated exact weighted first-return matrix identity and analytic singularity argument. The included symbolic verifier independently checks algebra and bounded enumeration; finite testing is not an infinite proof. No external independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact rational index distributions are proved at nesting heights 1, 2, and 3 only. The Gaussian law is for uniformly chosen height-at-most-three Dyck words as semilength tends to infinity; no statement about heights four and above. An equivalent unindexed special-case formula may exist.
title: Gaussian universality at Dyck nesting depth three
